Wheel-thrown stoneware with a softly swollen body, broad level foot and rounded C-shaped handle with two-finger clearance. A satin-glazed exterior retains visible throwing lines, while the interior is smoothly glazed. A narrow foot ring exposes the clay.
Wheel-thrown stoneware cup with a softly flared lip and small rounded loop handle, accompanied by a shallow circular saucer with a defined cup well. Glazed surfaces meet exposed-clay foot rings.

Wheel-thrown spherical stoneware body with a separately formed tapered spout and thick rounded loop handle. The exterior has a satin glaze, the interior is smoothly glazed and the level foot is unglazed. A domed lid seats inside a recessed gallery and includes a steam hole.

Small wheel-thrown stoneware jug with a gently tapered body, pinched spout and rounded strap handle with finger clearance. Glaze covers the interior and exterior, with fine horizontal throwing lines and an exposed-clay foot.

Squat wheel-thrown stoneware pot with gently rounded sides, a level foot, satin-glazed exterior and smoothly glazed interior. A shallow domed lid with a rounded knob sits on an inner gallery beside a small spoon notch.
Wheel-thrown stoneware plate with a broad shallow centre, softly lifted rim and trimmed level foot ring. The upper surface is glazed, with a narrow exposed-clay band along the underside edge.
Shallow wheel-thrown stoneware plate with a gently uneven circular outline, rounded lip and flat trimmed foot. A softly brushed glazed centre retains surface variation, with exposed clay beneath.
Wheel-thrown low stoneware bowl with outward-sloping walls, a rounded rim and broad foot ring. The interior is smoothly glazed, with fine throwing lines visible below the outer rim.
Wheel-thrown hemispherical stoneware bowl with a softly rolled lip, restrained exterior throwing rings and a wide trimmed foot. The interior has a glossy glaze, with exposed clay at the base.

Large wheel-thrown stoneware bowl with deep curved walls, a thickened rounded rim and a broad level foot ring. Glazed interior and exterior surfaces retain the character of the thrown form, with exposed clay along the bottom edge.

Hand-built stoneware slab platter with a gently irregular oval outline, shallow centre and softly rolled perimeter. The serving surface is glazed, and the underside has a broad, unglazed level support ring.

Wheel-thrown upright stoneware jug with a rounded shoulder, pinched lip and large arched strap handle with ample finger clearance. Glazed surfaces show faint vertical brushing above a flat exposed-clay foot.

Hand-built stoneware rectangular tray with rounded corners and a fitted box-shaped cover topped by a low bridge handle. Glazed interior and exterior surfaces retain soft slab seams, with a flat unglazed underside.

Small wheel-thrown cylindrical stoneware pot with gently rounded walls, a wide level foot and a shallow fitted lid with a thumb-sized knob. The exterior has a satin glaze and the interior is smoothly glazed.

Wheel-thrown stoneware bottle with rounded shoulders, a short narrow neck and pinched pouring lip. A small rounded handle joins the shoulder to the body. The vessel has glazed interior and exterior surfaces, a natural cork stopper and an exposed-clay base.
Hand-built elongated oval stoneware dish with a gently cupped centre, raised rounded edge and one shallow handle notch. The upper surface is glazed and the flat underside is unglazed.

Wheel-thrown stoneware egg cup approximately 6 cm tall, with a softly flared upper cup, short stem and wide flat pedestal base. Glaze covers the cup interior and exterior, with exposed clay beneath the foot.

Wheel-thrown straight-sided stoneware crock with a slightly flared opening, rounded rim and broad flat foot. A satin-glazed exterior retains pronounced horizontal throwing lines, and the interior is smoothly glazed.
Short hand-built stoneware loops with gently irregular oval profiles, approximately 2.5 cm wide. Satin glaze covers the inner and outer curves, while a narrow flattened underside exposes the clay.

Hand-cut circular stoneware discs with softly uneven edges, a slight raised perimeter and a low central recess. Glazed surfaces retain fine concentric impressions, and felt discs cover the undersides.

Wheel-thrown stoneware vase with a rounded lower body, gently drawn-in shoulder and short narrow neck with a softened lip. A satin-glazed exterior retains subtle throwing lines; the interior is smoothly glazed and the foot exposes the clay.

Wheel-thrown stoneware planter with slightly tapered walls, a rounded lip and one central drainage hole, paired with a wider flat-bottomed saucer. The planter interior is glazed, and both pieces have exposed-clay feet.
Wheel-thrown stoneware candleholder with a short central socket rising from a broad shallow dish and a flat circular foot. The visible surface has a satin glaze, with exposed clay beneath the base.

Hand-built shallow oval stoneware dish with a softly irregular outline, rounded lip and smooth central well. A brushed glazed centre retains handmade surface variation above an unglazed level underside.

Wheel-thrown cylindrical stoneware jar with gently rounded shoulders, faint horizontal throwing rings and a wide trimmed foot. A satin-glazed exterior surrounds a smoothly glazed interior. The fitted shallow-domed lid has a broad rounded knob and rests on an inner gallery.
